purpose: Relocate the reviewed Blog 2 tutorial into Accelerated Computing Hub without changing physics or rewriting measured evidence.

bootstrap.status: Pinned to the initial signed Hub runtime commit.
bootstrap.existing_checkout_policy: Verify origin and resolved commit; refuse another revision without reset or overwrite.

environment.previous_hub_stack: MuJoCo/MuJoCo Warp 3.12.0, Warp 1.17.0; its validation is historical, not evidence for this environment.
environment.container: Installs the original hash lock, then adds UI/test packages constrained to installed pins.
environment.notebook_metadata: Hub standard metadata is formatting policy, not a runtime Python version or GPU validation claim.

derived_inventory_policy: Current authored documents and any new root-owned container validation receipts are hashed from the current tree. Original imported runtime, dependency and evidence files remain exact-source guards.

adapted_original_code_cells.change: Public Hub repository/ref and layout only

retired_hub_path.reason: Earlier 3.12-specific helper is replaced by the imported measured source capacity/finite checks; no copied source runtime is edited.

test_adaptations: Source tests use relocated module/notebook paths.
The Hub asset-cache test targets Blog 2 download/resolve APIs with mocked Git commands; it does not import the Blog 3-only attestation helper.
The source CPU box integration fixture now explicitly requests the teaching protocol: 2000 control frames and 20 substeps, timeout 900s.
Hub CLI integration checks target physical box acceptance and incomplete-task rejection, replacing old 3.12-only stack assertion calls.
Hosted setup tests intercept all subprocess calls; no external actions occur.
Default Brev test entrypoint has a 1800-second limit and 15-second kill grace.
evidence_policy: All imported evidence/reference files are exact bytes, including historical paths, source archives, figures, failures and raw logs. LFS storage is transport only. Do not rewrite them to update links.
validation_limits: Imported workstation data is not a new Hub or container benchmark.
No local GPU, GUI, physics, Docker, hosted or network execution was performed by the porting agent.
Local tests use the existing Newton environment only for mocks/static contracts; its physics versions cannot validate Blog 2 execution.
Updated container/kernel/PC checks and final signed REF pin are root-owned separate steps.
